name: notif-diagnose
description: Ask the server directly what notifications.status returns and what optIn does, to find which gate (loaded/everOptedIn/supported) is hiding the bell toggle. Runner has no evalAsync, so fetches stash onto window and a later eval reads them.

steps.expression: (() => { window.__d = {}; fetch('/api/trpc/notifications.status').then(r => r.text()).then(t => { window.__d.before = t.slice(0,500); }).catch(e => { window.__d.before = 'ERR ' + e.message; }); return 'kicked off'; })()
steps.name: 1a - fire status BEFORE

steps.expression: (() => { fetch('/api/trpc/notifications.optIn', { method:'POST', headers:{'content-type':'application/json'}, body:'{}' }).then(r => r.text().then(t => { window.__d.optin = r.status + ' ' + t.slice(0,450); })).catch(e => { window.__d.optin = 'ERR ' + e.message; }); return 'kicked off'; })()
steps.name: 2a - fire optIn

steps.expression: (() => { fetch('/api/trpc/notifications.status').then(r => r.text()).then(t => { window.__d.after = t.slice(0,500); }).catch(e => { window.__d.after = 'ERR ' + e.message; }); return 'kicked off'; })()
steps.name: 3a - fire status AFTER
